visual_review: Before was a big flat-hemmed hair dome with a centred V fringe and a small face ring inside, reading as a helmet with a moustache; redrawn per the shared user.svg bust: round head resting on broad shoulders, a hairline sweeping from the left temple up past the crown, and the bob flicking out below both temples.
